units.text: Congress began its session in New-York on March 4, 1789, and the Resolution resolved that the Articles be proposed to the Legislatures of the several States.

units.text: The 1789 Joint Resolution explicitly proposed the amendments to the states, consistent with the claim that the First Congress sent them from New York.
